import json
T=[];L=[]
for fn,keys in [('my_sents3_01.json',['0','1']),('my_sents3_23.json',['2','3']),('my_sents3_45.json',['4','5']),('my_sents3_6.json',['6']),('my_sents3_7.json',['7'])]:
    dd=json.load(open(fn))
    for k in keys: T+=dd[k]; L+=[int(k)]*len(dd[k])
print(len(T), np.bincount(L))
prt=set(p['text'] for p in practice()); old=set(json.load(open('my_sents_all.json'))['texts'])
print('dup practice', sum(t in prt for t in T), 'dup old', sum(t in old for t in T), 'internal dup', len(T)-len(set(T)))
lens=[len(x['ids']) for x in tokenize(T)]; print(max(lens), np.mean(lens))
json.dump({'texts':T,'labels':L}, open('my_sents3_all.json','w'))
